# Immunity

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Damage and Healing](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Immunity)*

If you have Immunity to a damage type or a condition, it doesn't affect you in any way.
